name: list_pending
description: This agent's held writes that have not been applied and have not expired: waiting for the person's passkey (PENDING) or approved and ready to apply with write and approvalId (APPROVED). Each carries personMessage, one line to show the person verbatim, with the approval link (approvalUrl) and the equivalent basalt command (approveCommand). Listing touches no link: the link already given keeps working. If it was lost, call with reissueLink: true to get a new short link for each item (the earlier one stops working) and hand the person the new one. After showing a PENDING item's personMessage, call write once, in the same turn, with its approvalId and its runId, intent, statement as sql and params: that call waits for the person's approval and applies the write (see write for when the wait runs out). For an APPROVED item, that write applies at once. Newest first, cursor-paginated. Listing never approves anything.

runId.description: Only held writes of this run.

status.description: Only held writes in this state. Default both.

reissueLink.description: Issue a new short link for each item returned, revoking its earlier link. Default false: links are left as they are.

assignedColumns.description: Columns whose new values the approval binds (CONTRACT.md, Approvals).

rows.description: Rows the held write changes, cascaded rows included.

approvalUrl.description: The approval page for this held write: with reissueLink and when the engine serves the local pages, a newly issued short link http://localhost:<port>/approvals/<approvalId>#s=<secret> (the earlier one stops working); otherwise <base>/approvals/<approvalId>#1.<request> (base: the engine config's pagesUrl).

approveCommand.description: basalt approve --agent <name> [--config <path>] --open <approvalId>: the person runs it in their terminal and it opens the approval page in their browser.

headline.description: The held write in one line, cascaded rows stated ("Delete 1 row in public.leads + 2 cascaded rows (public.lead_notes 2)").

personMessage.description: One line to show the person verbatim: what is held, the approval link, the equivalent command and the expiry.
